set.body:
Source: upper-layer Site/pilot design review supplied by the user on 2026-07-23.

Problem:
Pilots cannot request a scheduler warning before walltime, so a higher layer cannot drain work and publish a result before Slurm termination without escaping into native options.

Scope and acceptance:
- Add a typed advance-signal request to JobRequest with validated signal identity, batch-shell/job-step scope, and lead seconds in Slurm's supported range.
- Lower it as one argv value to sbatch --signal without shell interpolation.
- Carry the field through site resolution, canonical managed requests, agent protocol, and local/SSH conformance.
- Provide an explicit worker drain-notice adapter or supervising-launcher design with deterministic tests; do not claim graceful JVM handling merely because sbatch sent a signal.
- Document early-delivery tolerance and distinguish advance notice from the terminal SIGTERM/SIGKILL sequence.
- Keep pilot/drain policy above slurm4s.
